Container.Name: coliseumgrid
Container.Overview: ColiseumGrid runs in-person video game tournaments: kids sign up with a gamer handle on a tablet, the host runs brackets and race heats from a laptop, and a TV shows who plays next. This image serves the app and keeps its database in the data path; create that folder and give it to uid 1000 first (chown 1000:1000). Online mode turns on rate limits for a server reachable from the internet; offline mode is for a home or venue network. Until host sign-in arrives, the host page answers any device that can reach it, so keep it off the internet. See docs/DEVELOPMENT.md in the repository.

Config.Name: Web UI port
Config.Description: Port for the host, sign-up, and display pages.

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: The database. Must be writable by uid 1000.

Config.Name: Mode
Config.Description: online behind a reverse proxy on the internet; offline on a home or venue network.

Config.Name: Trust proxy
Config.Description: The reverse proxy's address, so rate limits count each player's IP. Leave empty without a proxy.
